components.name: Code Card
components.description: Verbatim code with caption, yellow highlighter swipe and a pink handwritten margin note.
components.css: .ds-code{margin:0;background:#FFFDF8;border:2.5px solid #1B1A17;border-radius:16px 22px 14px 24px / 22px 14px 24px 16px;box-shadow:2px 4px 14px rgba(60,48,20,.12);overflow:hidden;font:400 15.5px/1.7 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:#1B1A17}.ds-code figcaption{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:9px 18px;border-bottom:2px solid #1B1A17;background:#F3EBD8;color:#6B6458;font-family:'Shantell Sans',cursive}.ds-code .file{font:600 16px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:#1B1A17}.ds-code .n{margin-left:auto}.ds-code .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:4.2em max-content}.ds-code .no{text-align:right;padding-right:16px;color:#6B6458}.ds-code .row.hl .t{background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 0,#FFE680 1%,#FFE680 98.5%,transparent 100%) no-repeat 0 55%/100% 86%}.ds-code .row.hl .no{color:#1B1A17;font-weight:600}.ds-code .note{margin:2px 0 8px 4.2em;font:600 16.5px/1.45 'Shantell Sans',cursive;color:#B21F5C}

components.name: Memory Sticky Note
components.description: Rotated sticky with tape; changed values get a pink swipe and a new tag.
components.css: .ds-memo{position:relative;background:#FFF3B0;color:#1B1A17;padding:26px 20px 18px;border-radius:3px 3px 18px 3px;box-shadow:2px 6px 16px rgba(60,48,20,.18);transform:rotate(.8deg);max-width:300px}.ds-memo::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-12px;left:50%;width:96px;height:26px;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg);background:rgba(189,237,229,.85);border-radius:2px}.ds-memo h4{font:700 19px 'Shantell Sans',cursive;margin:0 0 10px}.ds-memo dl{margin:0}.ds-memo .mv{padding:7px 0;border-top:1.5px dashed rgba(27,26,23,.25)}.ds-memo dt{font:600 15px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;opacity:.75}.ds-memo dd{margin:2px 0 0;font:400 15.5px/1.45 'JetBrains Mono',monospace}.ds-memo .new dd span{background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 0,#FFC3DD 2%,#FFC3DD 97%,transparent 100%);padding:0 2px}.ds-memo b{font:700 14px 'Shantell Sans',cursive;color:#B21F5C;margin-left:6px}

narrative.overview: A lesson is a hand-made zine about one codebase: dot-grid paper, black marker ink, and three flat highlighters. One long scroll of sketched panels in which a real input travels through real code. One thing is in focus at a time; there are no side-by-side panels and no dashboard chrome. Marker lettering and a hand-written annotation voice carry personality, while the reading surface stays calm enough for an hour of study.
keyCharacteristics: Dot-grid paper (22px grid, 1.2px dots) under every surface.
Marker face only for h1, h2 and big numerals; annotation hand face for labels and margin voice; sans for all reading text.
Uneven corner radii (--wob) on every drawn box; 2 to 2.5px ink borders; soft paper-colored shadows, never hard offsets.
Highlighter swipes are gradients with feathered ends, not flat rectangles.
The signature is the route drawing on and the contents rail ticking off stops.

rules.name: The Three Highlighters Rule
rules.body: Yellow means attention or change, pink means wrong or risk, teal means route or right. No color is used for decoration, and no fourth accent exists.

rules.name: The Ink-Text Rule
rules.body: Colored text uses the -ink variant of its highlighter (teal-ink, pink-ink, yellow-ink), never the fill color.

rules.name: The Marker Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Permanent Marker appears on h1, h2 and numerals only. Titles of cards, stops and questions are bold sans.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry no kicker or small label above them. Hand-face labels appear inline beside or below content as annotations, never stacked above a heading as a category tag.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: A raised thing has a 2 to 2.5px ink border and the soft lift; the shadow alone never defines an edge.

dos: Do use yellow for attention or changes, pink for wrong or risk, teal for route or right, and the -ink variant for any colored text.
Do set h1, h2 and numerals in Permanent Marker and every other title in bold Atkinson Hyperlegible.
Do keep doodles (mascot, arrows, squiggles, stars) in headings, the map, margins and state moments (gate, score, empty states).
Do give every drawn box --wob or an asymmetric variant, a 2 to 2.5px ink border, and the soft Paper Lift shadow.
Do keep narrative lines at or under 68ch and body at 19px or larger (18px on phones).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep the light and dark palettes in step.
donts: Don't put icons, doodles, or highlighter noise inside paragraphs; the only inline marks are code chips, glossary underlines and single swipes on short phrases.
Don't set body copy or cards' titles in the marker or hand faces.
Don't add eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't introduce hard offset shadows, a fourth accent color, or flat square corners on drawn boxes.
Don't return to side-by-side dashboard panels; the lesson is one scroll (the trace tabs only choose which trace to read).
Don't let the horizontal layout scroll the page at 390px; only the map and code rows scroll sideways.
